title: Thermal throttling probable
verdict: CPU sustained >90% with temperature >75 °C — the SoC will throttle shortly.
recommendation: Reduce load: kill the heaviest CPU consumer or improve cooling.

title: LAN ok, ISP/WAN down
verdict: Local network reachable but the public internet probe is failing — likely an ISP or WAN-side issue.
recommendation: Check the upstream router and ISP status; restart the modem if needed.

title: Memory pressure
verdict: RAM ≥90% with active swap usage — the system is paging.
recommendation: Identify and stop memory-hungry processes; consider increasing RAM if persistent.

title: Disk near full
verdict: Root partition ≥85% full — running low on storage.
recommendation: Free space: clear logs, prune Docker images, or extend the partition.

title: Disk critical
verdict: Root partition ≥95% full — services may fail to write.
recommendation: Free space immediately: clear logs and prune Docker artefacts.

title: Systemd service failed
verdict: One or more systemd units are in the 'failed' state.
recommendation: Inspect 'systemctl --failed' and restart or fix the affected unit.

title: Container unhealthy
verdict: One or more Docker containers are not in the 'running' state.
recommendation: Check 'docker ps -a' and restart the affected container.

title: Sustained packet loss
verdict: Packet loss ≥5% sustained for over a minute — connectivity is degraded.
recommendation: Check WAN link quality, ISP status, and physical cabling.

title: Temperature elevated
verdict: Core temperature ≥70 °C — approaching thermal throttling territory.
recommendation: Improve airflow or attach a heatsink/fan if not already present.

title: LAN devices offline
verdict: Three or more LAN devices offline for ≥2 minutes.
recommendation: Check the local switch/router and confirm devices have power.
